AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 18, 2020
REGULAR MEETING
  6:15 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Margarita L. Rios, Mayor
  Luigi Vernola, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

ROLL CALL
   Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(2): Significant exposure to litigation in one case.

  II.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54957: City Manager.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

INVOCATION
  Pastor Linda Nelson
  New Branch Ministries

FLAG SALUTE
  Alexander Nasario, 9th grade
  Downey High School

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
  City Council to recognize Holiday Home Décor Contest Winners.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS
  Liberty Utilities Community Outreach.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  February 4, 2020. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period January 12, 2020 –
  January 25, 2020, in the total amount of $930,209.29. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  January 30, 2020 through February 12, 2020, in the total amount of $1,937,864.04. 640

  Report
   4.  CLAIM AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by Guadalupe
  Monico. 830-13

  Report

  5.  AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 – AGREEMENT FOR PROFESSIONAL BUILDING INSPECTION
  SERVICES – Staff recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to the agreement with Bureau
  Veritas North America, Inc., to provide building and safety inspection services in an amount not to
  exceed $58,480; and authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 and any additional
  amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney.

  Report

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-14 – AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20
  BUDGET ACCEPTING LOS ANGELES COUNTY BOARD OF SUPERVISORS FUNDS TO SUPPORT
  THE COST OF A NEW PLAYGROUND AT HOLIFIELD PARK – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-14, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO ACCEPT LOS ANGELES COUNTY BOARD OF SUPERVISORS FUNDS TO
  SUPPORT THE COST OF A NEW PLAYGROUND AT HOLIFIELD PARK, in the amount of
  $300,000; and

  b.  authorize the City Manager to execute any agreements and or amendments, and documentation
  required by the County of Los Angeles, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City
  Attorney.
  610/920-03-04

  Report

  7.  REQUEST FOR USE OF CIVIC CENTER LAWN FOR CARNIVAL – CHANGE OF DATE AND
  ADDITIONAL WEEKEND - Staff recommends City Council approve the request of the Norwalk Float
  Foundation to change the original date to February 27 through March 1, 2020 and add an additional
  weekend from March 5 through March 8, 2020. 920-01-02

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  8.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

  9.  APPROVAL OF NORWALK SENIOR CITIZENS CENTER, INC. (NSCC, INC.) BOARD OF
  DIRECTORS - Staff recommends City Council approve the nominations of Julie Duran, President;
  Marlene Hardy, Vice President; Valarie Apodaca, Treasurer; Diane Richards, Secretary; and Yolanda
  Rodriguez, Member At Large to the Norwalk Senior Citizens Center, Inc. Board of Directors for one-
  year terms to expire December 31, 2020. 425-02-04

  Report

REPORTS

  10. LITTLE FREE LIBRARIES EAGLE SCOUT PROJECT – Staff recommends City Council approve the
  donation and installation of three Little Free Libraries at Hermosillo and Holifield Parks and the Cultural
  Arts Center.

  Report

  11. RESOLUTION NO. 20-13 - FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 MID-YEAR BUDGET REVISIONS - Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-13, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
   THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING MIDYEAR AMENDMENTS TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20
  BUDGET. 610

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated February 14, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
